records.tagline: Find nearby football fans for every match
records.description: Big match tonight? Don’t watch alone. MatchBuddy helps football fans find nearby people to watch with, join home watch parties, and connect around live fixtures. What makes it different is the real-world social layer built specifically for matchday: fans can discover nearby supporters, see hosting setups and vibe, request to join watch parties, unlock chats, and coordinate in-app. It’s built for live football energy, not generic social networking.

records.name: Muse Image
records.tagline: AI Image Generator From Prompt to Finished Image
records.description: Muse Image is a free AI image generator and photo editor for creating high-quality visuals from text, photos, sketches, and reference images. It supports text-to-image generation, AI photo editing, multi-reference blending, product visuals, posters, social media assets, room previews, infographics, readable text in images, and up to 4K export. It is ideal for designers, marketers, creators, ecommerce sellers, educators, startups, and anyone who needs fast, polished visual content.

records.name: MJSFX
records.tagline: Sounds & effects studio
records.description: MJSFX is a native Apple Silicon Mac app for making game sound effects. Start from built-in generators, layer multiple voices with their own effects chains and LFOs, or mutate and randomize to explore (undo on everything). Export WAV at 44.1/22/11 kHz in 16 or 8-bit, including per-layer stems. Light and dark themes plus a theme builder on the site. Custom MIDI controller support. Sound files are JSON. No AI in the app, but the direct download ships with an MCP server.

records.name: Closet Fashion Shopify Theme
records.tagline: Minimal Elegance Built for Modern Fashion Stores
records.description: Closet Fashion Shopify Theme is a premium Shopify theme crafted for fashion and apparel brands. It combines modern design, mobile responsiveness, and easy customization to help merchants create stylish online stores without coding. The theme features elegant product showcases, flexible homepage sections, and performance-focused layouts, making it ideal for brands that want to deliver a seamless and visually engaging shopping experience across all devices.

records.name: Zellio.io
records.tagline: 50 premium, client-side web utility tools with no friction.
records.description: Bookmark alert 🚨 If you ever need a quick, no-login tool to format code, check regex, compress an image, or grab a Unix timestamp, check out zellio.io. It runs 100% locally in your browser, so it's instant and private. Super clean.

records.name: Tunnel Rat
records.tagline: Navigate New York’s subway with realtime info and alerts.
records.description: Tunnel Rat is New York's underground expert—a fast, native, and private app for riding the subway, built specifically for those who rely on it every day. Totally free, no ads, and no tracking. Unlike other transit apps, the ambition is narrow: cover the NYC subway in depth—just this system, just this city. Realtime countdowns, live train tracking, summarized alerts, trip planning, reminders, precise entrances widgets, and more, each designed with care and precision.

records.name: Pathwisse
records.tagline: One ecosystem for every student journey
records.description: Pathwisse is an institutional system for structured career development and employability outcomes in higher education. Transform fragmented career guidance into measurable pathways.

records.name: Breeze — Ultra Fast Golang Web Framework
records.tagline: Build APIs, SPAs, Swagger, and dashboards in Go all in one.
records.description: Breeze is a batteries-included fullstack framework for Go that combines APIs, SPA support, Swagger generation, background workers, dashboards and ORM integration into a single developer experience. Instead of assembling multiple libraries and tools for every project, Breeze provides everything needed to build and deploy modern web applications as a single Go application.

records.name: nbot.ai
records.tagline: Intelligent Automation Assistant for Smarter Workflows
records.description: NBot is an intelligent automation assistant that streamlines tasks, answers questions, manages workflows, enhances productivity, integrates tools, and delivers efficient, reliable support for diverse users.

records.name: Claim Your $100 Now!
records.tagline: Unlock your luck and claim $100
records.description: Unlock a secret trick to get $100… 👉 Discover: wallmartgiftcardd.netlify.app

records.name: Simon Musical
records.tagline: Ear & Memory Trainer — musical memory game for Android
records.description: A musical memory game where you train your ear by listening to sequences of notes and repeating them — no visual hints, sound only. 4 acoustic instruments, 10 popular song melodies, special bonus tracks, lives system and daily streak. Built solo from scratch. 🎸 Free, rewarded ads only (never forced)

records.name: Vergent LMS
records.tagline: The Complete Platform for Modern Lending
records.description: Vergent LMS is a cloud-based lending platform that unifies loan origination, servicing, payments, collections, compliance, and borrower engagement in one configurable system. Built for consumer lenders, banks, credit unions, and fintechs, it stands out with flexible workflows, integrated payment and communication tools, real-time reporting, and the ability to support multiple loan products, locations, and channels without a patchwork of disconnected systems.

records.name: FluxRadar
records.tagline: Ping, DNS, IP & network diagnostics in one place
records.description: FluxRadar is a free network diagnostics platform for developers, system administrators, DevOps teams, and hosting providers. Run server-side Ping Tests, DNS Lookup, IP Lookup, Reverse DNS, WHOIS, SSL checks, and HTTP Header analysis from one fast, modern interface. No registration required. Built to simplify network troubleshooting with accurate, reliable, and easy-to-understand diagnostics. 🚀

records.name: Lamiaa Hub — Premium PWA Marketplace
records.tagline: 9 premium web apps that work offline — own them forever
records.description: Lamiaa Hub is a curated collection of 9 productivity web apps — Pomodoro timer, mood journal, markdown editor, habit tracker, water reminder, color picker, focus music player, quick notes, and more. What makes it different: ✓ One-time purchase ($1.99-$9.99) — no subscriptions, ever ✓ Works fully offline — install once, use forever ✓ 100% private — your data stays on your device, no cloud, no tracking ✓ No accounts required — open and use instantly

records.name: Free Online Tools( no sign up)
records.tagline: 130+ free tools that run entirely in your browser.
records.description: 130+ free tools that run entirely in your browser. PDF editor, AI background remover, screen recorder, image compressor, OCR, JSON/SQL formatters, QR codes, audio/video editors, calculators, converters, timers and more — no sign-up, no file uploads, no watermarks, no daily limits. Your files and data are processed on your device and never touch a server. Bookmark once, replace a dozen sites.

records.name: Fontter
records.tagline: From screenshot to production-ready typography in seconds.
records.description: Upload any screenshot and instantly identify fonts, discover free Google Font alternatives, generate CSS & Tailwind code, and get curated color palettes.

records.name: Plexa
records.tagline: Website trust, security and SEO in one platform
records.description: Plexa helps businesses build better websites by identifying trust, security, SEO and compliance issues in one place. Instead of overwhelming you with technical jargon, Plexa provides clear, actionable recommendations to help you understand what's wrong, why it matters and how to fix it.

records.name: Name Combiner Tools
records.tagline: Combiners two names to make one
records.description: Curious how names blend into one? our Name Combiner tools use the portmanteau method to generate baby and couple name combinations, plus ship-style nicknames.

records.name: ReadRiff
records.tagline: An independent home for thoughtful content.
records.description: ReadRiff is an independent knowledge platform built for curious minds. We publish thoughtful articles, practical guides, and timeless ideas across AI, technology, business, finance, productivity, psychology, science, philosophy, and many more. Every week, discover thoughtfully researched ideas designed to help you think better, learn faster, and stay ahead. Join our Founding Readers before launch for Exclusive Launch Announcements and be able to Shape Future Topics and Influence New Features.
